editions.sourceNote: Boundaries used for the 2024 election, including the revised districts in Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana, New York and North Carolina. Generalized for map display. Includes the 435 voting districts in the 50 states; excludes Washington, D.C. and the territories.

Boundaries used for the 2018 election, including the revised districts in Pennsylvania and Colorado. Generalized for map display. Includes the 435 voting districts in the 50 states; excludes Washington, D.C. and the territories.

Boundaries used for the 2022 election, from the Census Bureau’s annual 2023 cartographic release. This later release avoids the earlier Arkansas submission and the separate January 2023 interim boundary product. Generalized for map display. Includes the 435 voting districts in the 50 states; excludes Washington, D.C. and the territories.

editions.sourceName: U.S. Census Bureau and North Carolina General Assembly, 2020 election districts
editions.sourceNote: Census Bureau boundaries for the 49 states whose districts did not change, combined with North Carolina’s plan enacted in 2019 and used for the 2020 election. The Census Bureau confirms that North Carolina was the only state with changed congressional districts for that election. Generalized for map display. Includes the 435 voting districts in the 50 states; excludes Washington, D.C. and the territories.
